title: Westamerica Bancorporation Reports Fourth Quarter 2025 Financial Results
summary: SAN RAFAEL, CA: Westamerica Bancorporation (Nasdaq: WABC), parent company of Westamerica Bank, generated net income for the fourth quarter 2025 of $27.8 million and diluted earnings per common share ("EPS") of $1.12.
